name: +12V BATT
circuit: Main supply from the Class-T, 150 A max
note: S-028 p.8: 170 A continuous for the PMU 24 - the outputs' est_a sum is checked against it (params pmu_total_a, Y1)

name: GND
circuit: Device ground and flyback return for every inductive load

name: +12V SW
circuit: Wake input - diode-OR strip: ACC · RUN · door stage (A6) · horn/hazard/wink stage (A8) · brake (D-278) · O22 latch · DCU wake request (D-350)

name: +5V OUT
circuit: +5 V reference — dash node only: the two 100 kΩ bias resistors for A15 / A16 and the 100 Ω oil-node pull-up (D-260)
goes_to_fixed: Bias resistors + the 100 Ω oil-node pull-up, all on the dash node

name: CAN1H
circuit: Laptop / config bus, 1 Mbps. 120 Ω at BOTH ends (PMU end + port)

name: CAN1L
circuit: Laptop / config bus

name: CAN2H
circuit: Vehicle bus 500 kbps - the PMU's software termination ON at this end, 120 Ω at the far physical end, which is the dash node itself (D-318 moved it out of the engine bay; D-079 → D-346 set the two-terminator rule)
goes_to_fixed: The CAN2 splice at the node (N55), one lead

name: CAN2L
circuit: Vehicle bus
goes_to_fixed: The CAN2 splice at the node (N55), one lead

name: MOTOR_BUS
circuit: Pop-up motor bus — one splice feeds K1 / K2 contacts (30) and both coils (86); the PMU's soft fuse is the branch protection. Also the window bus N16 → L4-P 3, capped at the sill's F8 / F9 holders; the channel's retry class is conditional (D-357)

name: HEAD_LOW
circuit: Headlight LOW, both lamps
enable_basis: 100 W of halogen low beam at 13.5 V (section E scan, both lamps); capped at the 14 AWG branch limit (D-243). Corrected from 3.0 by T-017 - see LD01

name: HEAD_HIGH
circuit: Headlight HIGH, both lamps + the high-beam tell-tale sense at DP-ICU-B 12
enable_basis: 120 W of halogen high beam at 13.5 V (section E scan, both lamps); capped at the 14 AWG branch limit (D-243). Corrected from 3.5 by T-017 - see LD01

name: DEFOG
circuit: Rear defog grid — wired; channel configured and DISABLED (no control surface in this build)

name: FUEL_PUMP
circuit: Fuel pump — Carter P4070
goes_to_fixed: K13 terminal 30 (N69); K13 87 → receptacle L4-P 2 (N70) - the pump's mechanical back-stop (D-352, D-367)

name: IGNITION
circuit: Ignition — coils and igniters; also the F15 alternator-excitation branch the F16 branch (the display's backlight through the ICU), the F20 branch (the wideband gauge, D-244) and the F21 branch (the kick-down switch, D-320)
note: est_a 5.0 = loads LD12, coils and igniters only (4-6 A). The F15 / F16 / F20 / F21 branches have no loads row, so their draw is not in it; their fuse ratings (7.5 + 5 + 7.5 + 5 = 25 A) are ceilings, not draws

name: LS_ECU
circuit: Reserved for the LS swap — ECU + injectors

name: LS_FAN
circuit: Reserved for the LS swap — cooling fan

name: COMFORT
circuit: Comfort bus — the dash feed L3-P 2 → the L3-CMF receptacle behind the centre stack, where the O15 comfort block (A13, electrical's since D-451) plugs in (D-274); the sill mirror-heat feed left this output for the DCU's high-side switch (D-369). No load until the comfort block and its seats arrive
note: Feeds only the comfort block through L3-P 2 (N17). The sill mirror-heat feed (L4-P 4) left this output for the DCU's high-side switch (D-369); nothing else hangs here (R8).

name: BLOWER
circuit: Blower motor — steady feed; speed is the ≥ 20 kHz final stage at L3-BLW on the DCU's PWM (D-257); no motor this build: channel configured and DISABLED (K-023 · D-253)

name: TAIL_PARK
circuit: Tail · park · side markers · licence

name: BRAKE
circuit: Brake lamps
enable_basis: meas 7.0 A x 1.5 (R11; four 27 W stop filaments, SP-201)

name: WIPE_LOW
circuit: Wiper LOW brush — braking channel; also feeds K12 (washer) contact 30

name: WIPE_HIGH
circuit: Wiper HIGH brush

name: ACCESSORY
circuit: Accessory bus - head unit (ACC), USB-C, K12 coil, the ICU's logic rail (DP-ICU-A 1), the road-speed sensor supply (L4-S 4, D-272), and the hatch and fuel-door release branches, which is why ACCESSORY carries a release term (D-354). One capped module drop remains, DP-DCU 1, and it is no longer on this output - it went constant on F22 (D-350)
note: est_a 10 = loads LD15, the ~10 A worst case steady (both USB-C ports loaded); the release pulse is excluded (D-354)

name: HORN
circuit: Horns, both

name: TURN_L
circuit: Turn LEFT front + rear + tell-tale sense (DP-ICU-B 10) — flashed in the PMU

name: TURN_R
circuit: Turn RIGHT front + rear + tell-tale sense (DP-ICU-B 11)

name: REVERSE
circuit: Reverse lamps

name: INTERIOR
circuit: Interior lamp (via F12, PWM theatre fade) + illumination bus (dash lamps, the ICU's dimming reference, head unit)

name: START_RLY
circuit: Start relay K9 coil

name: KEEP_ALIVE
circuit: Keep-alive — feeds the wake strip through a diode and drives K11 (head-unit constant master)

name: HEADLIGHT_SW
circuit: Headlight switch ladder — OFF / PARK / HEAD-LO / HEAD-HI / PASS (12 V side, 12-bit)

name: KEY_POS
circuit: Key ladder — OFF / ACC / RUN / START (summed, 12 V side, 12-bit)

name: TURN_STALK
circuit: Turn stalk — LEFT / OFF / RIGHT

name: WIPER_STALK
circuit: Wiper stalk — WASH / HIGH / LOW / INT / OFF

name: BRAKE_PARK
circuit: Brake pedal + wiper park sense — 4 states

name: POPUP_L
circuit: Pop-up LEFT transit contact + inhibitor P/N contact

name: POPUP_R
circuit: Pop-up RIGHT transit contact + inhibitor R contact

name: DOOR_PINS
circuit: Door jamb switches, driver + passenger — 4 states

name: OIL_PRESS
circuit: Oil-pressure node — excited by a 100 Ω 1 W pull-up from pin 15 at the dash node (D-260); the PMU reads it for the fuel-pump gate, the ICU reads it too
goes_to_fixed: Tap on the L1-S1 4 → DP-ICU-B 2 conductor, at the dash node (N45)

name: HAZ_HORN_WINK
circuit: Hazard · horn · wink L · wink R — one summed ladder
